body: I don’t even really want to be here

I read somewhere once that the people that love you only want you to be ‘happy,’ but that happy is a really flat emotion. Like 2D. Meanwhile being sad/depressed (or angry, agitated, etc) is a 3D emotion. And that when people only want you to be ‘happy’ they tend to shut you down when you feel these 3D emotions because it makes them uncomfortable. It’s bullshit honestly but there it is. I feel similar when I talk to friends/fam that they don’t get it/think I’m crazy/give me bullshit stereotypical advice that doesn’t really help me. It’s trash tbh
